summary: Welcome to Physio Weekly for Sabaa, your briefing on the evidence and innovations shaping rehabilitation practice. I’m your host, and this week we have a substantial lineup of new research, followed by a look at technology adoption and emerging devices. Let’s start with the science, where a major new synthesis offers the clearest picture yet on designing digital programs for low back pain. A component network meta-analysis published in NPJ Digital Medicine pooled forty-six randomized trials involving nearly sixty-seven hundred participants.
